description: Read Medium stories by tag, author, publication, or story link. Returns one row per story with title, subtitle, link, author, publication, publish date, reading time, claps, responses, member-only flag, and tags, optionally the story text, plus a free summary row per source with its name and follower count.

authors.description: Medium usernames (netflixtechblog or @netflixtechblog) or profile links (https://medium.com/@netflixtechblog, https://name.medium.com).

include_text.description: yes to add each story's body as plain text, billed as a story with text. Member-only stories return the preview a logged-out reader sees, marked incomplete. Default no.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_stories_per_source.description: Stories to read from each tag, author, or publication. Default 25, maximum 2000.

publications.description: Publication slugs (better-programming), links (https://medium.com/better-programming), or the publication's own domain (netflixtechblog.com).

since_date.description: Optional. A date such as 2026-11-01, or a number of days back such as 7. Older stories are skipped and not charged.

story_urls.description: Links to single Medium stories, on medium.com or a publication's own domain. The story ID at the end of the link is what is read.

tags.description: Medium tags such as python or data-engineering, or tag links such as https://medium.com/tag/python.

name: get_medium_articles
title: Get Medium articles
